cases.name: unknown op
cases.reason: op name is not in the v1 vocabulary

cases.name: bad font
cases.reason: font_family must be in the backend text-element registry

cases.name: missing required field
cases.reason: edit_text requires both bar_index and text

cases.name: out of bounds text index
cases.reason: bar_index must point into the snapshot text bars

cases.name: duration beats rejected
cases.reason: set_clip_duration accepts duration_s seconds only, not beats

cases.name: split outside slot window
cases.reason: split_clip.at_s is assembled-output time inside the slot output window

cases.name: intro layout invalid layout
cases.reason: layout must be linear or cluster

cases.name: collapsed camera effect
cases.reason: camera effect end must remain after start after clamping

cases.name: camera effect out of bounds
cases.reason: camera_effect_index must point into the snapshot effects

cases.name: transition after final slot
cases.reason: boundary_index must identify two adjacent active clips

cases.name: unsafe transition
cases.reason: transition must use the render-safe allowlist

cases.name: unsafe visual fade
cases.reason: visual fade must be cut or fade
